title: 激光切割机：徽章项目上机全流程
source_doc: course/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/06_Laser Cutter 6 Badge Project.md
author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/06_Laser Cutter 6 Badge Project/src.py

points.K1: 放平材料，用固定针压稳
points.K6: 外偏移生成外框，设为切割

shots.scene: 欣欣站在桌面式激光切割机旁，手里举着一枚木质刻度尺徽章
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed desktop laser cutter holding up a small wooden ruler-shaped badge and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，从头到尾做一枚徽章。
overlay: 激光切割机：徽章项目上机全流程

shots.scene: 放料、设计、测距、看守、取件五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a wooden sheet, a design outline, a measuring arrow, an eye and a hand lifting a small piece. No people.
shots.narration: 放料、设计、测距、看守、取件。

shots.scene: 阿杰兴奋地拿着木板站在切割机前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a thin wooden sheet excitedly in front of the desktop laser cutter.
shots.narration: 阿杰要做第一个作品：名字徽章。

shots.scene: 小研站在切割机旁，示意阿杰一步一步来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside the laser cutter and gestures to the young male student to follow step by step.
shots.narration: 小研陪他，一步一步来。

shots.section_title: 放平材料，用固定针压稳
shots.scene: 小研抬起切割机的机盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the lid of the desktop laser cutter, revealing the honeycomb grid bed.
shots.narration: 先打开机盖。
overlay: 放平材料，用固定针压稳

shots.section_title: 放平材料，用固定针压稳
shots.scene: 阿杰把薄木板平放在蜂窝板上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lays a thin wooden sheet flat on the honeycomb grid bed inside the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 把木板平放在蜂窝板上。

shots.section_title: 放平材料，用固定针压稳
shots.scene: 两根固定针插进蜂窝孔，压住木板两边
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: two small metal pins are pushed down into the honeycomb holes on both sides of the wooden sheet, holding it in place. No people.
shots.narration: 固定针插进蜂窝孔，把木板压稳。

shots.scene: 阿杰双手轻轻合上机盖
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gently closes the laser cutter lid with both hands.
shots.narration: 关好机盖。

shots.scene: 屏幕上仍是空网格，鼠标点刷新后出现木板
shots.prompt_en: A blank computer screen shows an empty grid; a cursor clicks a refresh icon and a wooden sheet image appears. No people.
shots.narration: 画面不会马上变，点刷新才能看到木板。

shots.scene: 屏幕上打开文件夹图标，出现一把小刻度尺图形
shots.prompt_en: A folder icon opens on a blank screen and a small ruler outline with a rectangle around it appears on the canvas. No people.
shots.narration: 导入刻度尺设计文件。

shots.scene: 阿杰在键盘上打字，屏幕上出现空白文字框
shots.prompt_en: The young male student types on a keyboard; a blank text box appears above the ruler outline on the screen.
shots.narration: 用文字工具，输入自己的名字。

shots.scene: 几种不同风格的字母A图标
shots.prompt_en: Several letter A icons in different font styles in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 字体随你挑。

shots.scene: 文字框缩小，移到刻度上方
shots.prompt_en: The blank text box shrinks and moves to sit just above the ruler marks. No people.
shots.narration: 缩小一点，放在刻度上方。

shots.scene: 空心字轮廓和实心字并排，箭头从左指向右
shots.prompt_en: A hollow outlined letter shape next to a solid filled letter shape, with an arrow from left to right. No people.
shots.narration: 名字从划线改成雕刻。

shots.scene: 屏幕上名字变成实心
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the outlined name text fills in solid. No people.
shots.narration: 划线只刻轮廓，雕刻会把字填满。

shots.section_title: 外偏移生成外框，设为切割
shots.scene: 刻度尺只有细线，旁边剪刀图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: A ruler outline drawn with thin lines next to a scissors icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 刻度尺只有划线，还切不下来。
overlay: 外偏移生成外框，设为切割

shots.section_title: 外偏移生成外框，设为切割
shots.scene: 刻度尺外面多出一圈外框，箭头向外
shots.prompt_en: An outer frame appears around the ruler outline with small outward arrows showing the offset. No people.
shots.narration: 向外偏移一毫米，生成一圈外框。

shots.section_title: 外偏移生成外框，设为切割
shots.scene: 外框变成切割线，剪刀图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The outer frame turns into a cutting line and a scissors icon gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 把这圈外框设为切割。

shots.section_title: 外偏移生成外框，设为切割
shots.scene: 小研指着屏幕左侧的空白对象列表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a blank object list on the left of the screen while the young male student clicks.
shots.narration: 外框不好点，就在对象列表里选。

shots.scene: 三行步骤图标：虚线、笔刷、剪刀
shots.prompt_en: Three step rows with icons: a dashed line, an engraving brush and scissors. No people.
shots.narration: 现在有三个步骤：划线、雕刻、切割。

shots.scene: 材料卡片被清空，又重新选中木板卡片
shots.prompt_en: A material card slot goes empty, then a plywood card is selected again with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 打开新设计，材料设置会丢，要重选。

shots.scene: 步骤滑块停在默认位置，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three step rows with slider controls resting at default positions, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这个项目，用预设的默认参数就行。

shots.scene: 图案放在木板正中，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A small design outline placed in the very middle of a wooden sheet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 设计别放在木板正中间。

shots.scene: 多个小徽章从木板一角开始一行行排列
shots.prompt_en: Many small badge outlines lined up in neat rows starting from one corner of a wooden sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 从边角开始，一行一行排。

shots.scene: 阿杰把设计拖到木板角上，小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student drags the design to a corner of the sheet on the screen; the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 省材料，也方便下一位同学。

shots.scene: 屏幕上取景框框住木板一角
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a blank measuring frame is placed over a corner of the wooden sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 放好设计，先测距。

shots.scene: 激光头移动，镜头图标闪一下
shots.prompt_en: Inside the closed laser cutter, the laser head moves over the sheet and a small camera icon flashes. No people.
shots.narration: 机器移动拍照，自动测出距离。

shots.scene: 屏幕弹出空白输入框，小研用卡尺量木板
shots.prompt_en: A blank input box pops up on the screen; the female graduate student measures the wooden sheet with calipers.
shots.narration: 测不到会让你输厚度，一定要量准。

shots.scene: 距离箭头连着运动和功率两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A distance arrow linked to two icons: a moving laser head and a power gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 机器怎么走、用多大功率，都靠它。

shots.scene: 屏幕上一块立体木片，刻着空白名字和刻度
shots.prompt_en: A 3D preview on a blank screen of a small wooden piece with engraved blank text area and ruler marks. No people.
shots.narration: 预设材料可以先看三维预览。

shots.scene: 立体木片从木板上整块脱出
shots.prompt_en: The 3D wooden piece lifts out cleanly from the sheet in the preview. No people.
shots.narration: 名字雕刻、刻度划线、整片切下。

shots.scene: 屏幕上出现时钟图标和一条虚线路径
shots.prompt_en: A blank screen with a clock icon and a dotted path line tracing around the design. No people.
shots.narration: 点加工，能看到预计用时和加工路径。

shots.scene: 时钟图标显示一分多钟
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with a short arc showing a bit more than one minute. No people.
shots.narration: 这枚徽章，预计一分半钟左右。

shots.scene: 饼图中雕刻占了一大块，划线和切割很小
shots.prompt_en: A pie chart icon where engraving takes a large slice and scoring and cutting take small slices. No people.
shots.narration: 雕刻最费时，划线和切割放在最后。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸直手臂，站在切割机旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to the laser cutter with one arm stretched out toward it.
shots.narration: 运行时，人要在一臂之内。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在切割机旁，透过观察窗看着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits on a stool right beside the running laser cutter and watches through the tinted viewing window.
shots.narration: 眼睛盯着机内，随时能出手。

shots.scene: 烟雾、火苗、异常三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: rising smoke, a small flame and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 冒烟、起火、有异常，马上处理。

shots.scene: 阿杰的手伸向机器，可以随时干预
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, seated beside the laser cutter, reaches a hand toward its top panel, ready to step in.
shots.narration: 看得见里面，才能及时出手干预。

shots.scene: 屏幕上点开始，箭头飞向切割机
shots.prompt_en: A cursor clicks a blank start button on the screen and an arrow flies toward the laser cutter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 软件里点开始，只是把文件发过去。

shots.scene: 切割机上的启动按钮发出蓝光
shots.prompt_en: A glowing blue start button on the front of the laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 按下机器上的启动键，才真正开始。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下台下净化器的电源键
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the power button on the air purifier under the bench.
shots.narration: 启动前，先开烟尘净化器。

shots.scene: 净化器顶上三个蓝灯依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three blue indicator lights on top of the air purifier light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 风量指示要到三格。

shots.scene: 手指连按风量键，灯从一格加到三格
shots.prompt_en: A finger taps a fan button repeatedly and the indicator goes from one light to three lights. No people.
shots.narration: 不够三格，就按风量键调上去。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下启动键，坐在旁边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the glowing start button, then sits on a stool beside the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 按下启动键，坐在旁边看着。

shots.scene: 观察窗里激光头来回移动，有一点亮光和轻烟
shots.prompt_en: View through the tinted lid window: the laser head moves back and forth over the wooden sheet with a small bright dot and a wisp of smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 雕刻在先，切割在后。

shots.scene: 加工完，观察窗里还残留一点烟
shots.prompt_en: View through the tinted lid window after the job: a little smoke still lingers inside. No people.
shots.narration: 加工结束，先别急着开盖。

shots.scene: 烟被吸走，机内清澈，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The smoke is drawn out through the exhaust and the inside becomes clear, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 等机内看不到烟，再打开。

shots.scene: 阿杰打开机盖，拿出刻好的小木尺
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lifts the lid and picks the small wooden ruler badge out of the sheet with his fingers.
shots.narration: 开盖，把作品取出来。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着刻好名字的木刻度尺，开心展示
shots.prompt_en: The young male student proudly shows a small wooden ruler badge with a blank engraved name area.
shots.narration: 你的名字徽章完成了！

shots.scene: 净化器继续转一会儿，然后熄灯
shots.prompt_en: The air purifier keeps running for a short while, then its lights turn off. No people.
shots.narration: 做完就可以关掉净化器风扇。

shots.scene: 净化器图标旁一个小沙漏
shots.prompt_en: An air purifier icon with a small hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 多转一会儿也行，不必一直开着。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一个空白日历
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank calendar on the wall.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲收尾和预约。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现木板、固定针、刷新图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a wooden sheet, two pins and a refresh arrow.
shots.narration: 放平压稳，关盖刷新。

shots.scene: 笔刷、虚线、剪刀三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an engraving brush, a dashed line and scissors. No people.
shots.narration: 名字雕刻，外框切割，重选材料。

shots.scene: 测距箭头和木板角落的排列图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a measuring arrow and badge outlines lined up from a corner of a sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 从边角排，测距要准。

shots.scene: 净化器三格灯、眼睛、启动按钮图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an air purifier with three lights, an eye and a glowing blue start button. No people.
shots.narration: 开净化器，按启动，一臂之内看守。

shots.scene: 烟散尽的机内和取出的木片图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clear laser cutter interior and a small wooden piece lifted out. No people.
shots.narration: 烟散尽再开盖，取出作品。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着木质徽章挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small wooden badge and waves goodbye beside the closed laser cutter.
shots.narration: 一步一步来，做好作品，下次见！
